test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is 'prohibits'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option-

 
 
• exhibits- an object that is shown in a museum, etc. or as a piece of evidence in a court of law.
 
• *prohibits- to say that something is not allowed by law; to forbid.*
 
• establishes- to start or create an organization, a system, etc.
 
• inhibits- to prevent something or make something happen more slowly.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 2 is 'prohibits'.
 
• Thus, 'option 2' is the correct answer.

​

Correct sentence: *Article 15 of the Constitution **prohibits**__ discrimination against any citizen on the grounds of race, religion, caste, sex or place of birth.*
